# Mosaic Floor Panel Depicting Marine Life

GameCore theme sourced from a **real design object** in the Art Institute of Chicago.

## Work
- **Title:** Mosaic Floor Panel Depicting Marine Life
- **Artist / Maker:** Roman; Daphne, Turkey, the House of the Man of Letters, room 2
- **Date:** 200-230
- **Style / Period:** roman (ancient, style or period)
- **Classification:** mosaic
- **Department:** Arts of Greece, Rome, and Byzantium
- **AIC artwork ID:** 23276

- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/f59db4d0-7cba-e122-9f1d-5185afc6f6e9/full/400,/0/default.jpg
